msptmap.message.done: Analysis complete, open the map to view the result
msptmap.message.busy: Analysis failed: another player is already using the analyzer
msptmap.message.cooldown: Analysis failed: scanning too frequently, please try again later
msptmap.message.no_mod: Analysis failed: the server does not have MsptMap installed, or the versions differ
msptmap.message.mismatch: Analysis failed: MsptMap client and server versions differ
msptmap.message.version_mismatch: MsptMap client and server versions differ; results may be inaccurate
msptmap.message.waiting: The previous analysis has not finished yet; please wait for the result
msptmap.hint.server: Draw the Mspt map (requests the server)
msptmap.hint.singleplayer: Draw the Mspt map (in singleplayer, close the map and wait a while, or nothing can be generated)
msptmap.config.title: MsptMap Settings
msptmap.config.seconds_tooltip: Sampling seconds, converted by game ticks.
msptmap.config.relative_tooltip: When checked, colors are judged by the relative size within this scan: the heaviest chunk is shown in red and every other chunk is compared against it, making relatively laggy chunks easier to spot when the overall load is low. When unchecked, colors are judged by the fixed red threshold below.
msptmap.config.red_at_tooltip: A chunk costing at least this value is shown in the highest red level; chunks below it fade continuously from green through yellow to red. When "Relative mode" is checked this value is not used and cannot be adjusted.
msptmap.config.opacity_tooltip: Opacity of the heat fill. Range 0.05 ~ 1.00; the smaller the value, the clearer the base map underneath.
msptmap.config.reset_tooltip: Restore all settings to their default values.
msptmap.tooltip.doubtful: * this line could not be verified
